opening.argument: The title identifies this as a vlog, and the account behind its reference to free Panera is a personal incident, not an offer to viewers. The narrator says he is on his way to the doctor, then explains that his bag contained someone else's order. He considers keeping the food, but describes his own response to a mistaken order rather than directing the audience to a destination or asking them to take any consequential action. The reference to getting free Panera is thus addressed by what happened to the narrator; there is no solicitation for money, data, or participation.

citations.quote: HOW TO GET FREE PANERA | Vlog 4 | Sept 1 2016
I'm on my way to the doctor anyway
I opened my bag and I got someone else's order.
I think I'm just going to take it.
